changements: The app is now served from the root of its address, so the installed app and its offline cache follow.
The site publishes its version at /version.json.
Every change is now checked automatically (types, code style, tests, build) before it reaches production.
The project leaves Lovable: its code stays, and is now developed through La Fabrique and Claude.
Release notes now live in docs/release-notes.json.

titre: A real road in the 3D drive view
changements: The drive view now shows a real road in 3D.
Better memory use and smoother display.
Part of the code now relies on services (work in progress).
The distance to the next turn is easier to read.
A first 3D view of the road ahead, drawn from the road borders.
Very basic: road borders in wireframe only.
Tracks your position, speed and acceleration.
Search an address, or point and click on the map, to set a destination.
Once a destination is set, detects the next turn and suggests the speed to take it.
Detects the entry, apex and exit of each turn, and shows the turns on the map.
A progress bar before entering a turn.
A first "drive" view, seen from the driver's seat.
A settings screen.
A simulation mode to try the app without GPS.
A splash screen with credits.
Installs on your phone as an app (PWA).
